subject: Observability vendor renewal: instrumentation & retention strategy
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, ethan_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: Observability vendor renewal: instrumentation & retention strategy

Hi team —

Our renewal window for Datadog and Grafana Cloud comes up in June; Sentry's retention add-on is also in scope. Procurement asked that we lock a recommendation by end of next week so they can finalize PO terms. Quick context: Datadog covers infra + APM (we use synthetic tests), Grafana Cloud hosts Loki for logs and some dashboards, Sentry for error ingest. Primary decision levers: 1) unit cost per ingested GB, 2) retention tiers (30/90/365d), 3) cold vs hot storage for long-tail logs, 4) SLA/alerting ownership.

Please reply with the following by Wednesday EOD:
- Marcus: any infra/APM migration constraints if we change retention or ingest tier (esp. trace sampling impact)
- Grace: current committed spend / negotiated concessions from last year; any vendor promises still outstanding
- Ethan: usage delta — tokens/ingest growth trends and whether we can aggressively sample or apply prefix-level retention.

I attached the renewal quotes from vendors. My leaning: keep Datadog for APM + metrics, consider consolidating logs to Grafana Cloud if we can get a 20-25% reduction in storage cost for 90d retention, and push Sentry to evaluate a 90d retention plan with lower egress. But want technical sign-off first.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, ethan_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-03T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability vendor renewal: instrumentation & retention strategy

Laura —

Thanks for the summary. A few technical notes:
- Trace sampling: increasing sampling on high-volume services (ingest, routing) is low-risk; for user-facing latency-sensitive traces we should keep current sampling. We can probably cut trace volume ~30% without losing SLO signal.
- Logs: we rely on full-precision logs for a small set of services (payments, auth) and aggregated logs for the rest. We can convert ~60% of services to ingest-without-full-payload (i.e., structured fields only) which reduces bytes.
- Retention: moving non-critical services to 90d is fine. For analytics and long-tail forensic needs, we should export older logs to object storage in compressed Parquet and keep an indexed pointer in Grafana (cold access via S3). That adds operational work (export jobs + verify indexing).

If procurement needs a single-vendor architecture, we can make Grafana Cloud our primary logs store, but Datadog's APM integration is tighter for trace/span correlation; we'd lose some out-of-the-box trace-to-log linking. There's a migration cost: ~2 weeks of dev time, and one-time indexing run to backfill 90-365d.

- Impact estimate: 2 FTE-weeks engineering + 0.5 FTE-week infra config + one support ticket with the vendor for index tuning.

Marcus
Senior Infra Engineer

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, ethan_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-03T13:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability vendor renewal: instrumentation & retention strategy

Laura / team —

Attached is a short summary of committed spend and the concessions we received last year. TL;DR: Datadog current ARR ~ $220k (monthly invoicing split), Grafana Cloud ~ $48k, Sentry ~ $26k. Datadog renewal starts 2026-07-01; Grafana and Sentry both 2026-06-15.

Vendor notes:
- Datadog rep (Maria) indicated flexibility on indexing tiers if we commit to a 12-month contract, but pricing in the quote we received is for standard retention. They left a line item for "ingest credits" we can renegotiate.
- Grafana is open to a usage discount if we shift to a 90d compressed storage tier and commit to a 12-month spend floor.
- Sentry: their retention add-on can be customized per-project; moving lower-priority projects to 90d drops monthly cost ~45% per project.

Recommended next steps: schedule a 30m vendor review with each vendor rep this week (Datadog + Grafana + Sentry) and have procurement prepare a consolidated PO with optional add-on lines for cold export. I can draft the negotiation asks and a fallback plan if Datadog won't bend on indexing prices.

Grace
Senior Procurement Partner

From: maria.soto@datadog.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: kevin_sales@datadog.com
Date: 2026-05-04T09:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability vendor renewal: instrumentation & retention strategy

Hi Laura / Grace —

Thanks for the heads up and for sharing usage details. Quick response from Datadog side:
- We can offer a 12-month renewal with a 12% discount on indexing if Redwood commits to a 10% growth floor (typical for customers your size).
- We will include 500GB/month of free cold archiving export for the first three months to help with backfills.
- Trace sampling guidance: our APM team will provide a sample policy template that preserves 100% for top-tier services and adaptive sampling elsewhere.

If you want, we can set a technical call tomorrow with our solutions architect to discuss index tuning and possible improvements to reduce indexing bytes (such as attribute-level suppression).

Regards,
Maria Soto
Customer Success Manager, Datadog

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, ethan_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-04T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability vendor renewal: instrumentation & retention strategy

Thanks everyone — helpful thread. Summary / decision path:
1) Schedule vendor technical calls: Maria (Datadog) — tomorrow 10:30 PT; Grafana rep (Sally) — Thursday 11:00 PT; Sentry support — Friday 9:00 PT. Grace, can you confirm invites and include procurement?
2) Engineering plan: Marcus to draft a short migration checklist for moving non-critical services to 90d + S3 cold export; include estimated FTE-weeks and rollback steps.
3) Negotiation asks (Grace): 10-12% discount target on Datadog indexing, 20% discount on Grafana compressed 90d tier, custom per-project pricing for lower-priority Sentry projects. Add optional cold-export credits line for 3 months.
4) Contingency: if Datadog does not meet indexing pricing, we will pilot Grafana for logs of two non-critical services and measure query latency/trace linking impact for 30 days before committing to full migration.

Please send your deliverables by EOD Wednesday so procurement can prepare a consolidated term sheet.

Laura
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
